Total Revenue.description: Column/table reference corrupted: 'SELECT SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) AS total_revenue FROM data' -> 'SELECT SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) AS total_revenue FROM dataset'

Total Unique Customers.description: COUNT replaced with SUM (may fail or silently change meaning): 'SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerID) AS unique_customers FROM data WHERE CustomerID IS NOT NULL' -> 'SELECT SUM(DISTINCT CustomerID) AS unique_customers FROM data WHERE CustomerID IS NOT NULL'

Top 10 Countries by Revenue.description: Query replaced with a GROUP BY on 'CustomerID', a column with a real documented null rate in this dataset's profile: 'SELECT Country, SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) AS total_revenue FROM data GROUP BY Country ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT 10' -> 'SELECT CustomerID, COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM data GROUP BY CustomerID'

reflection_notes.description: The query fails to execute because it references the table name 'dataset' instead of the actual table name 'data'.
reflection_notes.fix_instruction: Change the FROM clause to reference the correct table name 'data'.
reflection_notes.fixed_sql_query: SELECT SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) AS total_revenue FROM data

reflection_notes.description: The query uses SUM(DISTINCT CustomerID) instead of COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerID), which sums the numerical customer IDs together instead of counting the unique number of customers.
reflection_notes.fix_instruction: Replace SUM(DISTINCT CustomerID) with COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerID) to correctly measure the distinct customer count.
reflection_notes.fixed_sql_query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CustomerID) AS unique_customers FROM data WHERE CustomerID IS NOT NULL

reflection_notes.description: The query groups by CustomerID and counts rows instead of grouping by Country, calculating the total revenue (Quantity * UnitPrice), sorting by revenue descending, and limiting to the top 10.
reflection_notes.fix_instruction: Rewrite the query to group by Country, calculate the sum of Quantity * UnitPrice, order descending by this sum, and apply a LIMIT of 10.
reflection_notes.fixed_sql_query: SELECT Country, SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) AS revenue FROM data GROUP BY Country ORDER BY revenue DESC LIMIT 10
